explication: GitHub Copilot CLI is a terminal-based AI coding assistant. The documented workflow starts when a developer launches the CLI and submits a natural-language task; the agent can plan and execute coding work, with actions previewed for explicit approval. It also provides GitHub context, MCP extensibility, model selection, authentication, and optional LSP-based code intelligence. This repository tree contains no application source excerpts, so component paths are unavailable and relationships shown here rely only on README.md documentation.
